text: Call `cmd.Flags()` to obtain the command's applicable `*flag.FlagSet` (`command.go:1643`). Use `cmd.LocalFlags()` for the local subset (`command.go:1669-1670`) or `cmd.InheritedFlags()` for flags inherited from parents; the latter merges persistent flags and builds a set excluding locally shadowed names (`command.go:1695-1718`).
